decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that is explicitly a flagship for the firm's organic growth direction, it is a low-cost option to keep open while market acceptance becomes clearer.

This organic snack line fits the firm's expansion into organic and convenient formats, so with only a short time on the market and no clear negative signal it is more sensible to continue than to abandon.

Although it is less central to the stated organic focus, it still matches the firm's core salami expertise and broad assortment strategy, so management would likely give the recent launch more time before dropping it.
